name: – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on election of the Commission
part_text:
This resolution does not change any law. It is an opinion from a political group stating that Parliament's vetting of the new European Commissioners was rushed and unfair. It asks for reforms: better checks on Commissioners' financial interests, an independent ethics body, fixed deadlines for evaluations, and more transparency so smaller political groups are not shut out of decisions. It also criticises the new Commission's programme on climate, social policy, asylum and arms.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it only calls for reforms to how Commissioners are checked.
- **Who it affects:** Future Commissioners, Parliament's smaller political groups, and EU citizens.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the European Council, the Council and the Commission; no binding action follows.
